name: dify-dsl-skill
description: Generate validated, automatically laid-out Dify DSL and optionally import and publish it to a local self-hosted Dify.

interface.shortDescription: Generate, layout, and locally publish Dify workflows.
interface.longDescription: Turn natural-language requirements into maintainable Dify Workflow and Chatflow DSL with Python Code-node authoring, canonical source synchronization, ELK automatic layout, deterministic validation, and explicitly authorized local self-hosted import and publication.
defaultPrompt: Create, auto-layout, and validate a Dify workflow from my requirements.
Configure trusted local sync for my self-hosted Dify, then import and publish this DSL.
Troubleshoot why this local Dify workflow failed to synchronize.
